lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-03-u16-wall-clusters/`** | **U16 wall clusters (cc-t3): the 30 non-lit keys of U13 stage A (219 runner records, no lit run in any window sign-off) fall into 19 first-fatal clusters; U14 owns 13 keys (11 predicted first-fatal moves), U15 owns 7 (4); the only unowned cluster with a predicted move is the empty android.net.wifi.WifiManager boot stub (fd-wifianalyzer, 8 invoked methods missing). Largest unowned: M2 WebView (4 alive keys, route a / A0). Top 5: Flutter EGL 4, M2 4, _ctype_ 2, Gecko/VLC LIBC 2, Bitmap ColorSpace 2.** |

- 2026-10-03 **sign-off 有两种 schema,计数前都读(cc-t3,U16 簇表)**:U13 window1–3 的 outer-signoff 每键给 runs/lit_runs/verdicts,window4 只给单个 verdict;只读前者会把 16 个 window4 亮键算成非亮(46 vs 30)。另:stub 类上的 NoSuchMethodError 要按 app 的调用集审整类——adapter-mainline-stubs 的 WifiManager 是空类(只有构造),wifianalyzer 调 8 个方法,只补报错那一个只会把 NSME 推到下一个。
